en.title: Russian An-12 military transport aircraft crashes in Siberia, all 19 on board killed
en.summary: A Russian Antonov An-12 military transport aircraft crashed in the Kemerovo region of Siberia on November 17, killing all 19 people on board, Russia's Defence Ministry said, revising an earlier media toll of 17; the ministry said the aircraft was on a scheduled flight, came down in an uninhabited area, and preliminary findings point to a technical malfunction.
body: A Russian Antonov An-12 military transport aircraft crashed in the Kemerovo region of southwestern Siberia on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, killing all 19 people on board, Russia's Defence Ministry said. The ministry said the aircraft was on a scheduled flight when it came down in an uninhabited area, and that preliminary findings indicate a technical malfunction caused the crash. An investigation is underway.

The ministry's figure of 19 people on board, including the crew, revised earlier Russian media reports that had put the death toll at 17. The Izvestia newspaper reported that the crash took place near the village of Yagunovo, south of the regional capital, and cited an eyewitness who said the aircraft was on fire before it descended sharply and exploded on impact with the ground. Kemerovo Governor Ilya Seredyuk confirmed that an aviation incident had occurred in the region's Yagunovo district and said he was headed to the site; he later said in a video message that the plane had been transiting through the region before it crashed.

facts.claim: A Russian Antonov An-12 military transport aircraft crashed in the Kemerovo region of Siberia on November 17, 2026, and Russia's Defence Ministry said all 19 people on board, including the crew, were killed.

The Defence Ministry said the aircraft was on a scheduled flight, came down in an uninhabited area, and that preliminary findings indicate a technical malfunction caused the crash, with an investigation underway.

Izvestia reported the crash took place near the village of Yagunovo, south of the regional capital, and cited an eyewitness who said the aircraft was on fire before it descended sharply and exploded on impact.

Earlier Russian media reports, cited by Reuters from Izvestia, put the death toll at 17, and Kemerovo Governor Ilya Seredyuk reported a plane crash near Yagunovo without identifying the aircraft involved.

zh.title: 俄軍安-12運輸機西伯利亞墜機、機上19人全數罹難
zh.summary: 俄羅斯一架安-12軍用運輸機11月17日墜毀於西伯利亞克麥羅沃州，國防部表示機上19人全數罹難，較俄媒稍早報導的17人上修；國防部表示該機當時正在執行定期飛行任務，墜落在無人居住地區，初步研判為技術故障，調查正在進行。
body: 俄羅斯一架安東諾夫安-12軍用運輸機於2026年11月17日墜毀在西伯利亞西南部克麥羅沃州，俄羅斯國防部表示機上19人全數罹難。國防部表示，該機當時正在執行定期飛行任務，墜落在無人居住地區，初步研判技術故障造成這起墜機事故，調查正在進行。
國防部公布的機上19人包含機組員，修正了俄羅斯媒體稍早報導的17人死亡。《消息報》報導，墜機地點在地區首府以南的亞古諾沃村附近，目擊者稱飛機起火後急速下降、觸地爆炸。克麥羅沃州州長謝爾久克證實當地亞古諾沃區發生航空事故並趕往現場，其後在影片訊息中表示，該機失事前正在過境該地區。
